title: The Unfinished Map
synopsis: Finn finds a map of Ooo with a whole region left blank and decides he will be the one to fill it in.
plot:
While cleaning out the attic of the Tree Fort, Finn discovers an old map of Ooo rolled inside a boot. Most of it matches the land he knows, but a wide patch to the east is simply blank, with the words 'nobody went' scrawled in the corner. Jake suggests that maybe nobody went for a reason, but Finn is already packing.

Princess Bubblegum explains that the Blank Quarter was left off every survey because the ground there refuses to be measured; instruments return different numbers each time. She lends Finn a Cartographer Snail that draws whatever it crawls over. Finn and Jake set out, and at first the region seems ordinary, just hills and a dry creek. Then they notice the hills are slowly rearranging themselves behind them.

The land, it turns out, is shy. It shifts because it does not like being looked at. Finn tries to force the snail to draw faster, which only makes the hills scramble harder, until Jake sits down, closes his eyes, and starts humming. The land settles. Finn realizes the map will never be finished by someone who is trying to pin it down, so he draws a single line, writes 'friendly, moves around', and leaves the rest blank on purpose. Bubblegum frames it anyway.
transcriptText:
Finn: Jake! Jake, look at this. There's a whole chunk of Ooo that's just... nothing.
Jake: It says 'nobody went.' That's a pretty clear sign, man.
Finn: It's a pretty clear invitation.
Jake: Those are not the same thing.
Princess Bubblegum: The Blank Quarter. Every survey team came back with different measurements. One of them came back with negative measurements.
Finn: So it's a mystery!
Princess Bubblegum: So it's a headache. Take the snail. It draws what it touches.
Cartographer Snail: I draw what I touch.
Jake: Cool snail.
[Finn and Jake walk through rolling hills. Behind them, a hill quietly slides to the left.]
Finn: Did that hill just move?
Jake: Hills don't move, Finn. That's, like, their whole thing.
[The hill moves again.]
Jake: Okay. Okay, that hill moves.
Finn: Snail! Draw faster!
Cartographer Snail: I have one speed and it is this one.
[The hills begin scrambling in every direction.]
Finn: Stop it! Hold still! I'm trying to KNOW you!
Jake: Dude. Dude, sit down.
Finn: What?
Jake: Just sit. Close your eyes. Hum something.
[Jake hums. Slowly, the hills stop.]
Finn: ...It's shy.
Jake: It's shy.
Finn: [writing on the map] 'Friendly. Moves around.'
Princess Bubblegum: That's the most accurate map of the region I've ever seen.
Cinnamon Bun: I'd go there.
